items.headline: $ZETA Ditches Its Own Chain, Migrates to Solana
items.summary: ZetaChain's Proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support to wind down its Layer 1 and move $ZETA to Solana. Exchanges must confirm the swap before a second vote sets the shutdown schedule.

items.headline: $WLFI Opens Vote on 180-Day Governance Rewards
items.summary: Trump-linked World Liberty opened a $WLFI vote on 180-day governance rewards, with payouts funded by the treasury and World Liberty Markets fees at no fixed rate.

items.headline: $GRAM Faces $52M Unlock Near a Full Day of Volume
items.summary: A $52 million $GRAM token unlock is landing near a full day of TON trading volume, putting the niche token's liquidity to the test.

items.headline: $PENDLE Launches RWAfi to Bridge DeFi and TradFi
items.summary: $PENDLE introduced RWAfi, a new product connecting DeFi yield markets with traditional finance returns — a fresh use case for the yield-trading protocol.

items.headline: $1INCH Spots Unique Liquidity Loop Across 4 Tokens
items.summary: $1INCH highlighted a distinctive liquidity loop involving four tokens, showcasing unusual DEX routing dynamics worth watching for onchain traders.
